innovation_presence.innovation: Clear evidence of a materially different approach, technology, mechanism, institutional arrangement, or delivery model.
innovation_presence.possible_innovation: Potential innovation signal exists, but available evidence is insufficient to make a confident determination.
innovation_presence.not_innovation: Routine project activity, standard infrastructure, ordinary capacity building, digitization, or established practice without evidence of substantive novelty.
innovation_presence.insufficient_evidence: The text does not provide enough information to assess novelty.

innovation_type.digital_data_technology: Digital platforms, data systems, remote sensing, AI, geospatial systems, digital infrastructure, or other technology-enabled approaches.
innovation_type.process_service_delivery: A materially different operational process, implementation mechanism, or service delivery model.
innovation_type.institutional_governance: New institutional arrangements, coordination models, governance structures, or organizational mechanisms.
innovation_type.financing_instrument: Results-based financing, risk sharing, matching grants, blended finance, performance payments, or other distinctive financing mechanisms.
innovation_type.policy_regulatory: New policy, regulatory, legal, incentive, or standards-based approaches.
innovation_type.product_service: A materially new product, service, tool, or solution provided to users.
innovation_type.other: Innovation that does not fit the categories above.

novelty_basis.explicit_novelty: The text explicitly identifies the activity as new, innovative, first, or pilot.
novelty_basis.new_to_context: The approach appears newly introduced in the country, institution, sector, or project context.
novelty_basis.adaptation: An existing approach is materially adapted to a new context.
novelty_basis.replication: An approach previously used elsewhere is being replicated.
novelty_basis.unclear: The basis of novelty cannot be determined from the text.

maturity_stage.concept: Proposed or designed but not yet tested.
maturity_stage.pilot: Being piloted, demonstrated, or tested on a limited basis.
maturity_stage.early_adoption: Implemented beyond initial testing but still at an early stage.
maturity_stage.replication: Repeated or transferred to additional settings.
maturity_stage.mainstreamed: Integrated into routine institutional or operational practice.

evidence_strength.explicit: The text directly states evidence supporting the classification.
evidence_strength.strongly_inferred: Evidence is strong but novelty is not explicitly stated.
